summary_1line: Nakula enters Virata’s court in disguise as horse-keeper Granthika while the Pandavas secretly support each other during their incognito year.

image_candidates.scene_text: Nakula, radiant like a celestial, stands before King Virata while examining the royal horses in the courtyard.
Arjuna as Vrihannala teaches princess Uttara and her companions music and dance in the women’s chambers.
The disguised Pandavas secretly exchange food, milk, cloth, and winnings at night, supporting one another within Virata’s palace.
